title: Friday all-hands: quick sync + Q&A prep (scratch)
content:
Purpose: rapid 12-minute update for the company on this week’s operational posture, quick product highlights, and an anticipated Q&A block. This is a scratchpad — keep short, empathic, and actionable.

Top-line message (20s):
- We had a busy week: improved median token latency for hosted API by ~8% after kernel tweak; Dedicated pilot is in early rollout; no customer-facing incidents this week.

CEO/Lead opener (approx 45s total):
- 10s: Thank you — short emotion/recognition for on-call and launch teams.
- 20s: One-sentence business context: adoption of Dedicated pilot is tracking ahead of forecast; hosting improvements mean better tail latency for most customers.
- 15s: Call out the ask: keep focusing on rollout hygiene and customer docs; we need two volunteers for a cross-functional canary review this week.

Engineering ops update (60s):
- What: Kernel selection change rolled to 3 AZs; median token latency -8%, p95 -3%.
- Impact: No customer tickets opened, billing impact minimal.
- Next: We will run broader perf validation w/ quantized model variants next Tues (ENG-4721).

Product/customer update (75s):
- Dedicated pilot: 6 customers live in alpha; two have requested higher egress throughput for embeddings.
- Private deployments: legal review complete; first on-prem baseline package scheduled for delivery to partner next month.
- Reminder: product team shipping new rollback tool to help SREs with faster fallbacks (PR 812).

SRE/Incident posture (40s):
- Current SLOs: all within target; small uptick in cache-miss rates for mid-size sequences — investigating (linked to perf validation).
- On-call rotation changes next week: shift start time moves 1 hour earlier to align with APAC partners.

Anticipated questions + short answers (Q&A bank)
1) Q: Any customer outages or data issues?
   A: No customer-facing outages this week; a single internal deploy caused degraded metrics for 12 minutes in staging only. We rolled back and are adding an automated guard (JIRA-OPS-330).

2) Q: Is Dedicated pilot going to be generally available soon?
   A: Not immediately — we want to validate scale and billing patterns in alpha. Targeting private beta in 6–8 weeks dependent on throughput validation.

3) Q: Will latency improvements increase cost?
   A: Not materially — most perf wins are from kernel and batching improvements that reduce effective token cost. We will surface any unit-cost impacts in next week's metrics dump.

4) Q: Any change to usage quotas or free tier?
   A: No changes this week; if/when we change quotas we'll give two weeks notice and a migration guide.

Do-not-say / guardrail lines
- Don’t promise GA dates for Dedicated.
- Don’t discuss specific enterprise pricing or contract negotiations.
- Avoid blaming individual teams — frame as system improvements and follow-up actions.

Parking lot items (for deeper dive post-all-hands)
- Walkthrough of rollback tool UX with SREs and solutions engineers.
- Embedded customer feedback on latency-sensitive workloads — collect example prompts for Optimize team.
- Dedicated pilot billing model edge cases to review with finance.

Stage cues and timing notes (for moderator)
- Slide 1: 00:00–00:20 (CEO opener)
- Slide 2: 00:20–01:20 (eng ops + SRE quick status)
- Slide 3: 01:20–02:35 (product + pilot update)
- Slide 4: 02:35–03:00 (ask / volunteers / next steps)
- Q&A: 03:00–12:00 (open mic; use seeded questions first)

Seeded Qs to open the floor (order to use if silence):
- 'Can you summarize what changed with token latency this week?' (engineering friendly)
- 'How are we managing Dedicated pilot customer expectations around throughput?' (product friendly)
- 'Any changes to on-call that affect coverage?' (SRE friendly)

Checklist (pre-meeting)
- [ ] Confirm updated slides with design (file: /company/all-hands/slide-v3)
- [ ] Confirm CEO/Moderator two-line opening
- [ ] Post agenda to #all-hands slack 30m before start
- [ ] Seed Q&A with 3 volunteers (Lena, Tomas, Maria)

Notes to self: short, conversational tone. Pause after any numeric claim and attribute source (perf dashboard link). If a tricky question appears about pricing or security, defer to a follow-up and offer to coordinate offline with the right team.

Open items I need to resolve before finalizing:
- Confirm exact p95 numbers after kernel rollout (ask perf dashboard owner: @zoe).
- Decide volunteer list and annotate who will moderate Q&A (Lena / Tomas?).
- Get sign-off on the 'no GA commitments' line from product leadership (Confluence comment required).

End of scratchpad. This is intentionally terse; copy into slide notes and tighten before final publish.
